reason: Net-additive bug fix: git_ops.py::GitOps::detach_lane_checkout now catches the RuntimeError (incl. WorktreeConflictError) its WIP commit raises on an unmerged index or a rejected commit and returns False without detaching, so Harness._reconcile_lane_checkouts routes a conflicted lane into its existing fail-safe re-pin branches instead of crashing orchestrator startup (task 4053). The total:private_reads rise is the new lane-importing regression file orchestrator/tests/test_lane_checkout_reconcile_conflict.py: all 11 are Harness privates (the sweep under test, Harness._reconcile_lane_checkouts, and the established startup_harness recipe's stubs of run()'s side-effect steps), none are lane internals. Not a refactor that failed.
